title: Bank of the James Financial Group, Inc. Announces Quarterly Dividend; Increases Quarterly Dividend by 25%
description: LYNCHBURG, Va., Jan.  19, 2024  (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- On January 16, 2024, the Board of Directors of Bank of the James Financial Group, Inc. (the “Company”) (NASDAQ:BOTJ), the parent company of Bank of the James (the “Bank”), a full-service commercial and retail bank, and Pettyjohn, Wood & White, Inc., an SEC-registered investment advisor, declared a cash dividend in the amount of $0.10 per common share. This is an increase of $0.02 per common share, or 25%, from the dividend declared in October 2023. The dividend is payable on March 15, 2024 to shareholders of record at the close of business on March 1, 2024.
